system.description:
Fortitude Amp

Your body manifests 8 fluttering tail feathers made of Star Chakra;

Cosmic Plumage. You gain temporary hit points equal to twice your maximum Star Chakra. If you begin your turn without these temporary hit points, you regain them.

Meteoric Speed. You gain a +10 bonus to your speed.

Star Power. At the beginning of each of your turns, you gain Temporary Star Chakra equal to half of your maximum Star Chakra.

Star Sickness Boon(s)

Star Sickness (1+ Rank): When you take Chakra damage, you siphon some of the attacks chakra, turning it into Temporary Star Chakra, gaining an amount equal to half the chakra damage they rolled.

Star Sickness (2+ Ranks): Hoshi clan Hijutsu you cast cannot be dispelled except by effects at least 1 rank higher than it.

Star Sickness (3+ Ranks): Increase damage you deal with Hoshi Clan Hijutsu by 2d6 force damage.

Star Sickness (4+ Ranks): You gain an additional Reaction each round, which can only be used to cast a Hoshi Hijutsu or use a Hoshi clan feature.

Star Sickness (5 Ranks): Hoshi Hijutsu and Kujaku abilities that inflicts ranks of Weakened or Bruised, now instead inflicts ranks of Star Sickness on hostile creatures.
system.summary: Temp HP of twice your max Star Chakra, renewed each turn. +10 speed, Temporary Star Chakra each turn, and Star Sickness boons.

rules.text: Cosmic Plumage: temp HP equal to twice your maximum Star Chakra; regain them if you start your turn without them.
Star Sickness penalties are suppressed while it lasts.
